claim: The HWCS-vs-N1 and HWCS-vs-N2 dominance conclusions are INDEPENDENT of the raster weight GAM
proof: GAM*p*rho appears on both sides of each comparison and cancels; break-even kappa depends only on rho
conclusion: HWCS beats N2 only for kappa < (p - 1/rho)/(q-p) = 0.071..0.567 across states; at kappa=1 it loses to N2 in ALL states, independent of GAM. HWCS beats N1 for kappa < (1-p-1/rho)/(q-p) = 1.071..2.567 (all >1 at kappa=1). The N2-conditional weakness is therefore NOT a raster-weight artifact.
